name: Vespid Dynamics Tracker Round System TRS-4 'Breadcrumb'
description: A modified rifle system that fires rounds containing a micro-transmitter that embeds in the target on impact and broadcasts location data for up to 72 hours. The TRS-4 round is a low-velocity subsonic projectile designed to penetrate clothing and embed in subcutaneous tissue without causing significant injury — the goal is tagging, not killing. The embedded transmitter is smaller than a grain of rice and broadcasts on a frequency detectable by Vespid's proprietary tracking receivers at ranges up to 5 kilometers. The round's low velocity means it feels like a hard punch rather than a gunshot, and many targets do not realize they have been tagged until the transmitter is discovered during medical examination.
specifications:
caliber: 8mm subsonic tracker round
muzzle velocity: 90 m/s — subcutaneous embedding velocity
effective range: 10-40 meters
transmitter size: 2mm x 1mm micro-chip
broadcast duration: 72 hours
tracking range: 5 kilometers with Vespid receiver
magazine: 6 rounds
weight: 2.5 kg rifle
injury profile: Minimal — subcutaneous embedding with bruising
story_hooks: A player character discovers a micro-transmitter embedded in their shoulder that they do not remember receiving — someone tagged them with a TRS-4 and has been tracking their movements for days.
A modified TRS-4 round has been developed that delivers a micro-dose of sedative along with the transmitter — targets fall asleep within minutes and wake up tagged.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purposeful rifle with a compact profile optimized for precision tracking rather than firepower. The design emphasizes control and accuracy over intimidation — it reads as a specialist's tool, almost clinical in its aesthetic. The barrel is notably shorter and thinner than traditional rifles, tapering to a precise muzzle.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 68 cm | Barrel length: 28 cm | Width at receiver: 5 cm | Height with sight rail: 12 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 2.5 kg — lighter than combat rifles, with weight distributed toward the grip for stability during precise aiming. Feels purposeful in hand without the heft of lethal systems.
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade aluminum receiver with polymer composite furniture. The barrel is treated steel with hardened coating to maintain micro-round tolerances.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed aluminum accents. The receiver shows a subtle anodized finish with minimal reflection — designed for surveillance operations where discretion matters.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary body with brushed steel receiver section. Accent highlighting in cold silver along the rail system and charging handle.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip with subtle vertical ridging — designed for gloved operation. Non-slip but quiet, with minimal squeaking. A small rubberized thumb rest on the left side.
distinctive_features: Ultra-compact 28cm barrel with precision rifling visible at muzzle
Rail-mounted Vespid proprietary micro-sight (small, angular optics)
Subtle transmitter loading indicator on the right side of the receiver — a small circular window showing remaining rounds
Magazine tube marked with faint Vespid hexagon patterns
Integrated sound dampening shroud around barrel (not a true suppressor, but reduces mechanical noise)
Charging handle with oversize knob for easy operation without lifting eye from sight
Small status LED port on the grip area (indicates round load status and transmitter health)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS engraved in sharp sans-serif font on the upper receiver, just forward of the rear sight rail. Serial number stamped on the left side of the receiver. Small hexagonal Vespid corporate logo stamped near the magazine well. QR code for registration etched on the grip.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-maintained and meticulous — surveillance tools are kept in premium condition. Likely shows light wear on grip areas and minimal dust on exterior. Transmitter loading indicator may show minor smudging from repeated use. Professional operators keep it clean; the penalty for a failed tag is investigative failure.
